title: Methodology, Statistical Assumptions, and System Constraints

target_definition.name: documented_occurrence_count
target_definition.unit: Integer count of qualifying occurrence records per calendar month
target_definition.meaning: Measures the frequency of verified scientific, diagnostic, or preserved pathogen samples deposited in official public biodiversity and agricultural repositories. It is an index of documented field surveillance activity and pathogen presence, not a complete census of farm-level disease incidence.
target_definition.missingness_policy: Months without observations are flagged as `is_missing = True` outside verified active surveillance windows. We never arbitrarily interpolate zeros to artificially complete a time series.

data_sources.name: GBIF Occurrence Search API (Techdocs OpenAPI v1)
data_sources.attribution: GBIF.org (2026). Occurrence Download accessed via GBIF REST API.

data_sources.name: NASA POWER Monthly Agrometeorology API
data_sources.attribution: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project.

data_sources.name: EPPO Global Database & Reporting Service
data_sources.role: Verified regulatory pest alerts, separating publication dates from event dates.

classical_models: ARIMA(p, d, q) Integrated Autoregressive Moving Average
SARIMA(p, d, q)(P, D, Q, 12) Seasonal ARIMA
ARIMAX / SARIMAX with strictly lagged NASA POWER weather regressors
modern_models: Meta Prophet (Additive/multiplicative yearly seasonality + exogenous regressors)
HistGradientBoosting and RandomForest Autoregressors (with cyclical month transforms)
statistical_framework.validation_strategy: Strict chronological train (70%) / validation (15%) / test (15%) splits without shuffling to prevent temporal lookahead bias.

scientific_limitations: Passive surveillance bias: occurrences reflect sampling intensity of research institutions and diagnostic labs.
Weather correlation does not prove biological causation: physical disease onset requires susceptible host phenology and microclimatic leaf wetness.
Forecasts beyond observed weather rely on transparent climatology scenarios, not realized future weather.
